allowedPatterns.title: Allowed command patterns
allowedPatterns.description: Glob patterns matched against JupyterLab command IDs. Only commands whose ID matches at least one pattern are returned by list_all_commands. If the list is empty, all commands are returned. Supports `*` (any sequence) and `?` (single character) wildcards. Example: ["notebook:*", "docmanager:open*"].

deniedPatterns.title: Denied command patterns
deniedPatterns.description: Glob patterns matched against JupyterLab command IDs. Commands whose ID matches any of these patterns are excluded from list_all_commands, applied after `allowedPatterns`. Supports `*` and `?` wildcards.
